sql: SELECT count(*),count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs.quarantine_ledger q WHERE q.table_name='obs.price_observation' AND q.observation_id=copy.observation_id AND q.revoked_at IS NULL)) FROM obs.price_observation o JOIN obs.price_observation copy ON o.superseded_by=copy.observation_id JOIN ref.product p1 ON p1.product_id=o.product_id JOIN ref.product p2 ON p2.product_id=copy.product_id WHERE copy.evidence ? 'reconciled_from' AND p1.product_code='rice_milled' AND p2.product_code='RICE_WHITE_LOCAL'
